coupling: The earlier HTJ2K header validation accepts the boundary value file_index == map.size(), while its checked map.at() access still rejects it safely. The later decoder cache optimization changes that access to unchecked map[], relying on the earlier range test. On the original earlier commit, the strict >= bound protects the unchecked access; on the earlier edit alone, at() protects it. Together, a crafted chunk with one channel and file_index 1 reads past the channel map. Repair requires restoring the bound/access invariant across both commits.
